component.name: Speedready
component.summary: Read in another language without losing the flow

description.p: Speedready is a reader for people learning a language. It paces you through an EPUB so you keep reading instead of stalling on every unfamiliar word, and it puts a dictionary one click away.

ul.li: Pacer: the whole text stays on screen and a highlight sweeps through it at your pace, dimming what you have read
RSVP: one word, or a short chunk, flashed at a time with the pivot letter marked
Double-click any word for its dictionary entry, looked up by dictionary form, so an inflected word still resolves
Right-click a word you do not know to underline it everywhere and make the pacer linger on it
Beginner mode prints a translation in your own language above each word you have not marked as learned yet
Have a sentence read aloud, or let the speech set the reading pace
Every word you look up is saved with the sentence it came from, ready to import into Anki

description.p: Dictionaries and voices are downloaded once and then work offline. Your position, speed and bookmarks are remembered per book.
